mathematics.assertion_tested: Explicit two-channel static response has one nonnegative amplitude per nonnegative spherical source. Deep-limit Gauss law and circular balance imply BTFR. Exact action primitive, positive response eigenvalues, and inferred exterior density.
mathematics.coefficient_domain: SymPy exact symbolic real arithmetic; Lean real analysis
mathematics.conventions: mu(y)=1-(1+lambda*y)^(-2), y=g/s, t=lambda*g/s. Positive constitutive scales. Isolated spherical static Gauss law with regular-source boundary flux. Deep-limit law is separately assumed in BTFR theorem.

bounds.symbolic: 13 exact identities and limits, all positive symbols; gradient identity for nonzero real vector.
bounds.lean: 9 named theorems, standard axioms only; source amplitude all nonnegative reals. No finite parameter sweep.

non_claims: No derivation of this constitutive choice from microscopic physics.
No covariance, cosmological evolution, lensing prediction or data fit.
No derivation of a0 or kappa; no particle-existence or particle-nonexistence theorem.
No global PDE existence from the pointwise spherical existence result.
